---
title: "Typst: inline references with citeproc"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
citeproc: true
references:
  - id: smith2020
    type: webpage
    title: A page
    author:
      - family: Smith
        given: Jane
    issued:
      date-parts: [[2020, 7, 12]]
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ["Smith"]
        - ['@smith2020']
---
